name: ui_live_test on ui_live_test_c1
description: Generated by assay2chip S5 (s5_group) from the unit operations of 'ui_live_test' and the chip plan in partition.json: load, incubate, wash, lyse share one board; they run between 37 and 37 C; 5 of the 6 ports allowed at demo scale; 22% of the envelope Built to the demo envelope (30 x 20 mm, 0.3 mm deep, 1 layer). Modules are in flow order, one library part each, in the format chip/designs/README.md defines, so chip/components/build_chip.py runs on this file unchanged.

modules.does: The port takes in what is to be processed.
The polygon chamber is held at temperature, is flushed to clear its contents and receives the lysis reagent and holds.
modules.why_no_part: no Flowmatter part in chip/components/catalogue.json has the shape of block 'polygon_chamber' (assay2chip/parts/flowmatter.py); S6 sizes it from physics instead, so this module has a block but no catalogue shape

off_chip.why: this op holds live cells at 98 C, above the 37 C in contracts/parameters.json culture.temp_c, and protocols/thermal_map.md records everything from 42 C onward as lethal, so no chip may do it to live cells - and this rests on a LOW-CONFIDENCE op (confidence 0.25): the placement is only as good as the step it came from, so treat it as provisional

note: chip/components/build_chip.py cannot build this design: module(s) polygon_1 sit on blocks that no Flowmatter part in chip/components/catalogue.json has a shape for, and that builder places a library STL per module. Each module's `block` is the authoritative identity and S6 sizes the part from physics through assay2chip/parts/, so the chip is built from this design either way; what is lost is the Flowmatter display model. No part name has been invented to paper over it.
